description: This file contains unit tests for the AnySoftKeyboard input method, specifically testing text selection modification features such as capitalization, wrapping with special characters, and input connection behavior.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardSelectionModificationTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying text selection modification features in the AnySoftKeyboard input method.

methods.name: testCapitalizeEntireInput
methods.description: Tests the capitalization of the entire input text and toggling between lowercase, capitalized, and uppercase states.

methods.name: testNoChangeIfNotSelected
methods.description: Verifies that pressing shift does not alter text when no text is selected.

methods.name: testCapitalizeSingleWord
methods.description: Tests capitalization and case toggling for a single word within the input.

methods.name: testStartsCapitalized
methods.description: Checks behavior when input starts with capitalized text and toggling case states.

methods.name: testCapitalizeMixedCaseWord
methods.description: Verifies case toggling on a mixed-case word.

methods.name: testWrapWithSpecials
methods.description: Tests wrapping selected text with various special characters and brackets, ensuring correct nesting and output.
